test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'CYLINDER' is written as 'CYLJNDFR', 'CERTAIN' is written as 'CFRTBJN', and 'PURPOSE' is written as 'PVRPPSF'. How will 'QUEUEING' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

**Logic: **

**Vowel: Addition of + 1 in Vowels.**

**Consonant is written as it is.**

'CYLINDER' is written as 'CYLJNDFR'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2002f4ed13d2d3066f42261b4b3a3e44fd1700a5468464ed9d73e63384d039c0.png] 

And,

'CERTAIN' is written as 'CFRTBJN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76d3b378f964da946557606fd58539c97c566133fdcb73bb35bdc7994dc352a.png] 

And,

'PURPOSE' is written as 'PVRPPSF'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4619964c386954e059c14914e67e5147050a799777c381d6717ebfd6787a1d3f.png] 

Similarly,

'QUEUEING' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8de5c8599a54476872515790cdebe2204d2c53c2bdda455084dad4866cd22db7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"QVFVFJNG".**
